intro: The account and dashboard with the new tokens and components, not redesigned: practical, calm and readable.

shell.title: Account and dashboard frame
shell.permissions: Only the sections your permissions allow are shown.
shell.note: On phones the sidebar comes above the content, which takes the full width. The current page is ink on the page ground, with an accent line at its start.

chat.title: Conversation
chat.subject: Reviewing bylaws before adoption
chat.first: I attached the current draft and the org chart. What worries us most is the delegation chapter: who signs what.
chat.reply: I've read them. The delegation chapter needs one session with you and the finance director before any change. I've suggested a time below.
chat.composerError: Your message wasn't sent. What you wrote is kept; check the connection and send it again.
chat.typed: Thank you, Sunday works for me.
chat.note: A conversation is correspondence, not bubbles: each message is a row under a hairline, sender and time in a fixed column, your own messages on the raised ground. Messages always render as text.

meeting.title: Meeting card
meeting.changed: The meeting link changed. We've emailed you the new details.
meeting.note: Times are in the reader's zone, and the zone is always named.

documents.title: Documents and viewer
documents.viewerNote: Every opening is logged. The watermark with your name and the date is on every page. The link lasts 60 seconds.
documents.note: Only the viewer's frame changed: the watermark, the 60-second signed link and the opening log are as they were.

table.title: Tables
table.caption: Consultations

rows.title: Governance charter for a family business

table.note: Sort, filter, select and an action per row. Hairlines between rows, no zebra stripes. On phones each row is a block.

stats.title: Numbers and chart
stats.note: What needs action comes first, its number in the accent. The chart is flat bars, the current month alone in the accent, and the axis starts at zero.

editor.title: Content editor
editor.heading: A referral path run by residents
editor.situationValue: أربعة مخيمات، ولا طريقة واحدة يثق بها الناس للإبلاغ عن الخطر.
editor.changedValue: بعد عام، صار أغلب البلاغات يصل عبر اللجان المحلية.
editor.englishError: Write the English title, or leave all of the English empty.

editor.note: A tab per language, and an incomplete tab carries a mark. The publish panel is the only raised ground on the page.
